svg.title: TOAD expert network and runtime topology
svg.desc: Declared TOAD network and runtime implementation. The operator uses OpenStack and SSH. DNS resolves the app name to the load-balancer floating IPv4. Octavia forwards TCP 80 and 443 to the three private Swarm managers. The routing mesh reaches one pinned Traefik replica, which terminates TLS and routes to the app. SSH, outbound routing, monitoring and mTLS administration are distinct paths. Public IPs are reserved examples; this is not a live health or placement map.

svg.text: SSH key, CA key and age identity
Parent NS delegates the child zone
Record TTL 60 s; zone TTL 300 s
App HTTPS uses the public entry
Public apps need their own auth policy
YOUR CLOUD PROJECT · HEAT STACK my-cloud
Private VMs use it for egress
Separate from the app / SSH IP
TCP checks: delay 10 s / timeout 5 s / retries 3
TCP passthrough: no TLS termination here
Swarm: quorum 2/3 · ingress 80/443 · overlay pool 10.20.0.0/16 (/24 allocations)
Stateless copies or explicit pinned local volume
Global Alloy / node-exporter / cAdvisor; blackbox HTTPS checks; local state volumes
Public IPs are reserved documentation examples. Private IPs and ports are declared profile defaults.
Topology is an implementation model, not live health or task placement. Detailed sources, trust and failure behavior follow below.
